other_conditions: Must be studying in a government school under the scheme
Must be a girl student who secures at least 75% marks in Class 10 board examination
Two meritorious students (first and second position) per district are selected
One BPL student (first position) per district is selected
One orphan girl (first position) per district is selected
The selected students must continue regular studies up to postgraduate level
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 per year for class 11‑12 students and up to ₹2,00,000 per year for graduate and postgraduate students.
